author: By Erin McGroarty
title: Madison alder could be first transgender member of Legislature
text: Madison City Council Ald. Dina Nina Martinez-Rutherford would replace state Rep. Francesca Hong. Former Ald. Juliana Bennett also is running for the Assembly seat.
